{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of severe patients and the number with valid biomarker_baseline
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']
valid_biomarker_count = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0].shape[0]
total_severe = severe_patients.shape[0]

valid_biomarker_count, total_severe"}
